item.title: ODOT explores freeway connection to alleviate U.S. 23 congestion
item.description: The Ohio Department of Transportation is hosting open house meetings to gather public input on a potential new freeway connection between U.S. 23 and Interstate 71 in Delaware, Marion and Morrow counties, in an effort to ease congestion and improve safety.
